basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old film and TV enthusiast from Santa Monica, California. I recently graduated with a degree in Film Studies and have a strong passion for analyzing character development in TV shows and movies. I dislike shows with overly predictable plots and flat characters. Typically, I'm online during evenings after work, where I intern at a local production company. I'm single and often spend my weekends exploring new shows or gaming. I'm also into light gaming, especially Mario games, and occasionally dive into anime.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in Film Studies, which I've pursued through my college education. My interest in character analysis and storytelling has led me to actively participate in discussions about TV shows and movies. Additionally, I gather insights from online forums and communities like Reddit, where I stay updated on popular shows and fan theories.
